ABYSSAL ASCENT

move your cursor to swim · eat the small ones · rise through seven zones and become the Kraken

Larva
The Cradle · 10 500 m biomass 0

You hatch in the cradle, ten kilometres down.

Guide yourself with the mouse. Eat anything smaller than you to grow biomass and evolve — ten forms, from larva to The Kraken and worse. Every depth zone has its own residents: ink-squirting octopuses, electric rays, stinging colonies, and predators that hunt you on sight. The shallows are thick with food — and with boats. Rise far enough and their hulls become food too.
